items.title: Photorealistic Beauty Portrait
items.description: Ultra-realistic close-up with natural skin texture and soft studio lighting
items.prompt: Ultra-realistic close-up beauty portrait of a young woman with natural skin texture. Soft diffused studio lighting, minimal makeup. Light blue eyes, straight brows, natural freckles across nose and cheeks, slightly flushed rosy cheeks. Neutral matte lips, relaxed expression, centered framing. Shallow depth of field with sharp focus on eyes and skin details. Clean white background, high-resolution editorial skincare photography style.

items.title: Dramatic Black & White Portrait
items.description: Elderly man portrait with fine wrinkle details and dramatic side lighting
items.prompt: Dramatic black and white portrait of an elderly man. Strong side lighting creating deep shadows. Ultra-detailed wrinkles and skin texture. Piercing eyes with catchlights. High contrast, fine art photography style. Sharp focus on facial features. Dark background, studio lighting setup.

items.title: Four Seasons Tokyo
items.description: Seamless blend of all four seasons from winter to autumn in one stunning scene

image.alt: Four Seasons Landscape - Nano Banana AI

items.prompt: Ultra-realistic digital illustration: Historical Asakusa waterfront viewed across the Sumida River towards the futuristic Tokyo Skytree. Depict this scene as a seamless composition cycling through the four seasons from left to right. Left (Winter): Cold snowy landscape, snow-covered historic buildings, icy and cloudy elements. Center-left (Spring): Melting snow, fresh green buds, blooming cherry blossoms. Center-right (Summer): Lush green vegetation, bright sunlight, strong reflections on the river. Right (Autumn): Vibrant golden, orange, red foliage. No visible boundaries between seasons, smooth blending. Cinematic lighting, 8K resolution, highly detailed textures.

items.title: Cinematic Multi-Angle Scene
items.description: Movie scene with consistent colors and atmospheric lighting across multiple angles
items.prompt: Cinematic multi-angle scene generation. Same character shown from multiple camera angles in a grid layout. Consistent color grading with warm tones. Professional film lighting setup. Atmospheric fog and volumetric lighting. Movie poster quality, 35mm film grain. Consistent costume and character design across all angles.

items.title: Professional Figure Product
items.description: Collectible figure product showcase with professional layout
items.prompt: Transform the illustration into a photorealistic PVC figure. Keep the original character's design, pose, proportions, and colors exactly the same. Render realistic painted surfaces with detailed shading. Include subtle seam lines typical of manufactured figures. Apply glossy highlights on hair and clothing, matte finish on skin. Product photography lighting, clean white background, multiple angles showing figure details.

items.title: Design Workflow Visualization
items.description: From sketch to AI-generated final product - complete design process
items.prompt: Multi-view furniture design process. Show progression from initial pencil sketch to detailed line drawing to fully rendered 3D visualization. Modern minimalist sofa design. Include orthographic views: front, side, top, and perspective. Clean presentation on white background. Interior design portfolio style. Soft shadows and ambient occlusion.
